name: Karolína Muchová
intro: Karolína Muchová is a tall, tricky player from Czechia. She is the No. 7 seed. A seed is a ranking badge for top players. She can hit every shot in the book.
story: Her dad was a pro soccer player. He showed her tennis at age seven. She played handball too. At 12 she picked tennis for good. This summer she reached the Wimbledon final. Wimbledon is a Grand Slam, one of the four biggest tournaments. In New York she won two singles matches. She also won the mixed doubles trophy here with Jakub Menšík! What a summer.

funFacts.text: Her nickname is Muška. In Czech that means little fly.
Her dad Josef was a pro soccer player in Czechia.
Her brother Filip is a soccer goalkeeper.
As a kid she played handball. At 12 she chose tennis.
Her childhood hero was Roger Federer.
Her serve can zoom at 110 miles per hour.
She just won the US Open mixed doubles title with Jakub Menšík.

watchFor: Watch for her drop shot, a soft shot that barely hops over the net.
